# ionhour Provider

Manage [Ionhour](https://ionhour.com) projects, HTTP checks and heartbeat jobs through the Integration API v1.

Authenticate with an API key. For automation, use a workspace-owned **SERVICE** key with `serviceRole` `MEMBER` (deletes need `ADMIN`) covering `mcp:projects`, `mcp:checks` and `mcp:jobs`. The provider calls `GET /v1/whoami` when it is configured, fails early on an invalid or inactive key, and logs the workspace it acts on at INFO (`TF_LOG=INFO`).

~> **State holds secrets.** `ionhour_job.ping_token` and `ping_url` let anyone send OK heartbeats for the job, and `ionhour_check.config.custom_headers` often carries credentials. Terraform state stores them in plain text: use an encrypted remote backend.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    ionhour = {
      source = "ionhour/ionhour"
    }
  }
}

# Credentials come from IONHOUR_API_KEY (and IONHOUR_API_BASE_URL for SIT/UAT)
# when the attributes are omitted.
provider "ionhour" {
  api_key = var.ionhour_api_key
}

variable "ionhour_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Ionhour API key (`ionh_...`) sent as `Authorization: Bearer`. Falls back to the `IONHOUR_API_KEY` environment variable.
- `base_url` (String) Integration API base URL including the `/api` prefix. Falls back to `IONHOUR_API_BASE_URL`, then `https://api.ionhour.com/api`. Override it for SIT/UAT.
